latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of langextract (version 0.1.0).
- Google-developed Python library for extracting structured information from unstructured text using LLMs.
- Provides precise source text mapping for each extraction, supporting traceable, enterprise-level use cases.
- Compatible with Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, and supports interactive HTML visualization of results.
- Includes features for long document processing, batch operations, and filtering based on source text alignment.
- Suitable for applications in medical, legal, literary, and general domain information extraction.
